snippet.title: Poly Fighter - Official Demo Launch Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Get a look at the Demo Launch Trailer for Poly Fighter, a single-player roguelike fighting game developed by HeartLoop Games. Players will learn new moves from every opponent they defeat to build their fighter’s unique style. Battle through tense retro-arcade duels with a choice of simple or motion inputs to master your moveset and claim your title. Poly Fighter is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
